content.text: Salt draws water out of meat through osmosis. Drag the slider to see how resting time affects the meat's surface before searing.

keyStates.state: Osmosis pulls water to the surface. Meat is wet. Searing now will cause steaming and grey meat.
Brine is reabsorbed, breaking down tough proteins. Surface is dry again. Perfect for a golden Maillard sear.

validation.question: Arrange the steps to properly cook Boeuf Bourguignon to maximize flavor:

options.text: Sear beef in batches on high heat
Pat meat dry with paper towels
Deglaze the fond (browned bits) from the pan
